title: Southwest earned more without carrying more traffic
question: Did the reported revenue increase come with more passengers and passenger miles, or with greater revenue per customer and seat?
comparability_limits: Each change uses its own Q3 2025 denominator. Percentage changes do not make passenger count, passenger miles and seat miles economically interchangeable.
Average fare is per revenue passenger; route length, product and passenger mix can change it. It does not by itself identify pure pricing, volume demand or causal effects of commercial initiatives.
Use the displayed operating revenue total of USD 8,422 million and USD 6,949 million; do not substitute the sum of rounded revenue components.
Two comparable third quarters establish a year-on-year comparison, not a continuous multi-quarter trend.
Mobile layout: five short horizontal rows, visible zero baseline, signed labels rounded to one decimal for display, and a shared linear axis; no separate truncated axes or dual units.
